mentions.name: HowBazaar.gg
mentions.description: A companion website for the video game The Bazaar that makes game information more accessible. After finding shortcomings in the info the game itself provides, the site extracts and presents data from the game files, and it has since earned official support from the game company.
mentions.problem: The video game provided insufficient information about itself, so the site's builder dug into the game files to surface that data more accessibly for players.
mentions.audience: Companion site for players of the video game The Bazaar, popular with the game's community.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building https://www.howbazaar.gg/ which is a companion website for the video game https://playthebazaar.com/!

I was enjoying playing the game, there were some shortcomings in the info it provided, I dug around and found the info in game files, and decided to make that info more accessible.
